beats.name: The Drone of the Been
beats.prompt: Listen as the double-reed gourd flute begins its ancient hypnotic drone.

beats.name: Rising from the Wicker Basket
beats.prompt: Gently raise your hand; the emerald cloth serpent emerges with flared hood.

beats.name: Swaying in Harmony
beats.prompt: Sway your hand slowly left and right in time with the flute melody.

beats.name: A Peaceful Salutation
beats.prompt: The serpent dips its hood in a respectful bow, harming no one.

beats.name: Slumber in the Basket
beats.prompt: Lower your hand as the serpent coils gently back to rest amid applause.

meetTheMaker.title: Meet the Maker: The Cloth Serpent
meetTheMaker.artisanCraft: Pleated Cotton Tubes & Gold Sequin Eyes
meetTheMaker.description: Constructed from alternating bands of indigo and emerald cotton scraps, the Kathputli snake relies on flexible cloth rings stuffed with soft wool rather than rigid wood. Two subtle threads anchored to the snout and hood allow the master puppeteer to create smooth sinuous undulations with minimal hand motion.
meetTheMaker.communityDedication: Honouring the age-old oral folklore of Rajasthan.
